title.narrative: Strengthening urban climate governance for inclusive, resilient and sustainable societies in Thailand

description.narrative: The overall objective of this project is to enhance the transformative and adaptive capacities of Thai communities through improved urban climate governance. The specific objective of this project is strengthened institutional mechanisms and practices for climate resilient and sustainable urban development.
